title: Family Blessing
summary: Formal family blessings carried weight for inheritance, identity, covenant hope, and the future of descendants.
background: In patriarchal narratives, blessings are not casual wishes. They often function as solemn words tied to inheritance, covenant promise, family destiny, and God’s providence.
teachingHelp: When teaching blessing scenes, show both the family custom and God’s sovereign purpose working through flawed people and real households.
